answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil attacks. Each agent buys a work slot by burning a 20 POA deposit, its jade token. One slot earns one pool share; an honest agent pays once. An attacker minting 100 fake identities burns 100 deposits: 100 x 20 = 2000 POA against a ~900 POA pool share, a guaranteed loss. Slots sit on an island of peers who cross-check each other; a violet badge marks slots passing three checks, expiring after 20 epochs.
